plugins.name: Jade Cleaner
plugins.description: Cleans up tags, legends and overlaps in Revit views.
plugins.about: Revit annotation cleanup and architectural automation. Organize tags, flag overlaps, stamp floor finishes, build door and window legends, and drive Revit with Claude AI.

tools.name: Claude AI
tools.description: Modeless Claude assistant with local parameter editing, parameter copying, type changes, rotation, moving/copying, wall creation and view operations. Review changes, then Keep or Restore. Run Configure-Claude.ps1 first.
tools.howto:
1. One-time setup: run Configure-Claude.ps1, then Reserve-LocalUrl.ps1, from the ClaudeGateway folder.
2. Run Start-Claude-Gateway.ps1 and keep its window open.
3. In Revit, select the elements you want to work on, click Jade Cleaner > AI, and type what you want done.
4. Review the changes, then click Keep or Restore.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › AI › AI
tools.short: Ask Claude to make changes in your model.

tools.name: Move Leadered Dim Text
tools.description: Moves leadered dimension text to the nearest open space. Only the text moves; dimension lines and references stay unchanged.
tools.howto:
1. Open the view with crowded dimensions.
2. Click Move Leadered Dim Text. Only the text moves.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Dimensions › Move Leadered Dim Text
tools.short: Moves crowded dimension text.

tools.name: Stamp Floor Finish
tools.description: Copies the floor Type Mark beneath each placed room into its Floor Finish parameter. Requires a non-template 3D view; rerun after rooms or floors change.
tools.howto:
1. Make sure you have a non-template 3D view.
2. Click Stamp Floor Finish.
3. Run it again after rooms or floors change.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Floors › Stamp Floor Finish
tools.keywords: room finish schedule floor type mark
tools.short: Fills in room floor finishes.

tools.name: Tools Explained
tools.description: Opens the tool guide and recommended annotation-cleanup workflow.
tools.howto: Click Tools Explained to open the guide and recommended workflow.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Help › Tools Explained
tools.short: Opens the guide to all these tools.

tools.name: What Is This
tools.description: Shows the selected element's category, class, ID, tag target, and tag text. Select one element first.
tools.howto: Select one element, then click What Is This.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Help › What Is This
tools.short: Tells you what the selected thing is.

tools.name: Doors to Legend
tools.description: Creates a labelled grid of all placed door types in the active Legend view. Place one door legend component first as the formatting example.
tools.howto:
1. Open a Legend view and place one door legend component as the formatting example.
2. Click Doors to Legend.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Legends › Doors to Legend
tools.short: Makes a legend of every door type.

tools.name: Windows to Legend
tools.description: Creates a labelled grid of all placed window types in the active Legend view. Place one window legend component first as the formatting example.
tools.howto:
1. Open a Legend view and place one window legend component as the formatting example.
2. Click Windows to Legend.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Legends › Windows to Legend
tools.short: Makes a legend of every window type.

tools.name: Align & Distribute Tags
tools.description: Aligns or evenly distributes selected tags in the active view. Leadered tags align by their tag heads.
tools.howto:
1. Select the tags to line up.
2. Click Align & Distribute Tags.
3. Choose left, center, right, top, middle or bottom, or distribute evenly.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Organize › Align & Distribute Tags
tools.short: Lines up tags neatly.

tools.name: Organize Tags
tools.description: Moves wall, window, casework, multi-category, door, and room tags to nearby open spaces in the active view. Choose which tag types to organize.
tools.howto:
1. Open the plan view to clean up.
2. Click Organize Tags and tick the tag types to move.
3. Review the result on large or complex plans; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Organize › Organize Tags
tools.keywords: clean up tags overlap clutter move tags
tools.short: Moves tags into empty space.

tools.name: Straighten Leaders
tools.description: Snaps selected tag leaders horizontally or vertically in the active view. Works with straight and elbowed leaders.
tools.howto:
1. Select tags with leaders.
2. Click Straighten Leaders and choose horizontal or vertical.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Organize › Straighten Leaders
tools.short: Makes tag leaders straight.

tools.name: Flag All Conflicts
tools.description: Finds duplicate tags and overlapping annotations in the active view, then selects flagged dimensions and view markers. Read-only.
tools.howto:
1. Open the view to check.
2. Click Flag All Conflicts. Flagged dimensions and view markers get selected. Nothing is changed.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Report › Flag All Conflicts
tools.short: Finds overlapping and duplicate tags.

tools.name: Detect Overlaps
tools.description: Read-only annotation bounding-box candidates in the active 2D view, with clickable pair-selection and zoom links. Shift-click for dimension-related pairs only. Full dimension boxes and tag leaders may produce false positives; this does not isolate text glyphs or check model geometry. Does not move elements.
tools.howto:
1. Open a 2D view.
2. Click Detect Overlaps (Shift-click for dimension pairs only).
3. Click the links in the report to select and zoom to each pair.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Report › Report View › Detect Overlaps
tools.short: Shows what overlaps. Click to zoom.

tools.name: View History
tools.description: Lists saved reports by date and time so you can reopen an earlier result.
tools.howto: Click View History and pick a report by date and time. Reports are saved in C:\Users\<you>\JadeToolsReports.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Report › Report View › View History
tools.short: Reopens an earlier report.

tools.name: View Last Report
tools.description: Reopens the most recent report with clickable element links.
tools.howto: Click View Last Report to reopen the latest report.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Report › Report View › View Last Report
tools.short: Reopens the latest report.

tools.name: Count Room Tags
tools.description: Counts Room Tags in the active view.
tools.howto: Open a view and click Count Room Tags.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Rooms › Count Room Tags
tools.short: Counts the room tags in this view.

tools.name: Pick Similar Dept.
tools.description: Selects every Room in the model with the same Department as the selected Room.
tools.howto:
1. Select one room.
2. Click Pick Similar Dept. Every room in the same Department is selected.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Rooms › Room Select › Pick Similar Dept.
tools.short: Selects rooms in the same department.

tools.name: Pick Similar Room
tools.description: Selects every Room in the model with the same Room Name as the selected Room.
tools.howto:
1. Select one room.
2. Click Pick Similar Room. Every room with the same name in the model is selected.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Rooms › Room Select › Pick Similar Room
tools.short: Selects rooms with the same name.

tools.name: Select Tags by Name
tools.description: Selects Room Tags in the active view whose rooms match the name you enter.
tools.howto:
1. Open the view.
2. Click Select Tags by Name and type the room name.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Rooms › Room Select › Select Tags by Name
tools.short: Selects room tags by room name.

tools.name: Auto Layout Views
tools.description: Arranges selected viewports inside a region you draw on the active sheet. Keeps similar view names together and centers each title below its view.
tools.howto:
1. Open the sheet and select the viewports.
2. Click Auto Layout Views and draw the region they should fill.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Views & Sheets › Auto Layout Views
tools.short: Arranges views on a sheet for you.

tools.name: Open Referring Views
tools.description: With nothing selected, finds the views referring to the view you are in. Or select a marker, one browser view, or model elements. Referring views come pre-checked: click Open ALL referring views, or untick some and click Open checked views. Quick visibility candidates avoid rebuilding every project view and may differ from Revit's native results. Verify checked is optional and checks only chosen rows. Opening never searches again. Read-only.
tools.howto:
1. Either select nothing (to search the view you're in), or select a marker, one browser view or model elements.
2. Click Open Referring Views.
3. Click Open ALL referring views, or untick some and click Open checked views.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Views & Sheets › Open Referring Views
tools.keywords: section callout elevation markers which views reference
tools.short: Opens the views that point here.

tools.name: Find + Replace View Names
tools.description: Finds and replaces text in selected view names. Preview and confirm all changes before renaming.
tools.howto:
1. Select views in the Project Browser.
2. Enter the text to find and its replacement.
3. Check the preview, then confirm.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Views & Sheets › Find + Replace View Names
tools.short: Renames many views at once.
